open_points.subject: ServicePrincipal scope mode and producer-project grant creation
open_points.text: “with it the scope mode alone admits an import for any project the Registry reports active, and no project grant is consulted” and “ProducerProjectGrant … consulted only when the principal's `scope_mode` is `granted_projects`” do not say whether `grant_producer_project` may create an inert grant for an `all_projects` principal or must refuse it
open_points.question: May an administrator create or revoke ProducerProjectGrant records for a ServicePrincipal whose immutable `scope_mode` is `all_projects`?
options: Allow such grants; persist and audit them, but never consult them
Reject grant creation for `all_projects` principals as inapplicable; define whether any pre-existing grant may still be revoked
open_points.default_guess: Reject creation for `all_projects` principals, while permitting revocation of any existing record.

witness.initial: An active `all_projects` ServicePrincipal exists, and Registry reports project P active.
events: An administrator invokes the producer-project grant action for that principal and P.
outcomes: The portal creates and audits an active ProducerProjectGrant that can never affect authorization.
The portal refuses the action because an `all_projects` principal cannot use project grants.
witness.observer: The administrator sees success versus refusal, and later readers see different persisted grant and audit facts.

open_points.subject: Timing and transaction of imported-section linking
open_points.text: The section says imported plans and new sections “must do so before activation so that operators can re-allocate to those sections,” while `BudgetActivationResult` is created only after “activation, section linking, previous-version deactivation, and audit commit atomically.”
open_points.question: Are imported plans and linked/new PortalSection records created in a separate pre-activation action, or are they created atomically by activation?
options: Build and persist plans/sections before activation; operators then re-allocate and a later activation transaction only validates, switches versions and audits
Create/link plans and sections inside the atomic activation transaction
open_points.default_guess: Build and persist the candidate version’s plans and sections before activation, because operators must be able to target them while resolving allocations.

witness.initial: Project P has an active old budget and an expense allocated to an old section; a candidate snapshot contains a new unmatched source section.
events: Staff starts preparation of the imported candidate.
An operator attempts to re-allocate the expense to the candidate’s new section.
outcomes: The preparation action has already minted and persisted the new PortalSection and SectionPlan, so re-allocation can succeed before the later activation.
No section or plan exists until the atomic activation; the operator cannot perform the required pre-activation re-allocation, so activation cannot satisfy its own unresolved-allocation precondition.
witness.observer: The operator sees whether the candidate section exists before activation, and persistence/audit readers see which action minted it.
